prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified. THREE rows TWO columns. TOP TIVER adult woman care worker, sturdy middle-aged proposed look, dark hair beneath simple cream headscarf, faded russet dress and plain grey apron, holds one small wooden water cup, calm firm stance. MIDDLE GULAN adult man local limited grain organizer, thick greying black hair and beard, brown sleeveless overcoat over desaturated olive tunic, small tied personal purse at belt and empty hands, reserved guarded posture, not military commander, no faction insignia. BOTTOM FIL adult man old weaving-street foreman, balding dark hair, square grey beard, faded navy work smock, brown belt and boots, small unmarked CLOSED order ledger under arm. No table seat, ration distributed, contract signed, coercion scene or claimed permanent rights over another person.
